title: She Always Found Me
about: Looking back on how two people kept finding each other during ordinary walks around the fair before either understood what it meant.
description: This track looks back at the quiet beginning of a relationship that didn't announce itself as important at the time. During walks around the fair, different groups and circumstances somehow kept placing us beside each other. What seemed like coincidence then feels different in hindsight. It's about how some of life's most meaningful beginnings don't arrive dramatically, they simply keep putting two people on the same path until the pattern becomes impossible to forget.
lyrics: Every time we'd head out walking,
Somehow you'd end up by my side.
Still we'd fall into the same stride.
I never stopped to question why,
Never thought much of it then.
Like the story knew the end.
Out of all the winding pathways,
Long before we called it anything,
Every time I walked with you.
Just another lap around the fair,
Neither one of us was searching,
I thought it all was coincidence,
